summary: Representative Joyce has not acknowledged catastrophic risk from AI. The only relevant statement found from Representative Joyce welcomes investment in a Stargate AI data center.
Representative Carey has not acknowledged catastrophic risk from AI. The only relevant statement found from Representative Carey is about the energy costs of data centers.

Representative Brecheen has not acknowledged catastrophic risk from AI. Their statements on AI are about curbing China's influence over AI, China's use of AI as a weapon and for cyberattacks, and monitoring weaknesses in AI systems.

Representative Bonamici has acknowledged catastrophic risk from AI by co-signing a letter, but not in their own words. A September 2026 letter they co-signed names risks of "agentic misalignment, mass cybersecurity breaches, and development of biological or chemical weapons". In their own words, they have called for safeguards so "powerful models don't cause the next disaster".

Representative Perry's recent remarks on AI are about the race with China, data centers, surveillance cameras and AI in health care. Chairing a 2025 hearing on AI and biosecurity, Representative Joyce warned that hostile nations may exploit AI biological design tools: "These risks are not theoretical."
